content: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation): Applies to any project handling EU personal data. Key requirements: lawful basis for processing, data minimization, right to erasure ('right to be forgotten'), data portability, 72-hour breach notification, Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) for high-risk processing, and appointment of a DPO if required.

HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act): Required for any project handling US healthcare data (PHI). Key requirements: Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with every vendor, encryption at rest and in transit, access controls with audit trails, minimum necessary standard, breach notification within 60 days, and 6-year retention of compliance records.

SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act): Applies to any project touching financial reporting systems for publicly traded companies. Key requirements: internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR), audit trails for all financial data changes, segregation of duties, access controls, and annual attestation by management and external auditors.

SOC 2 Type II: Required for SaaS/service providers handling customer data. Five Trust Service Criteria: Security (required), Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality, Privacy (optional). Key requirements: access controls, encryption, monitoring, incident response, change management, and a 6-12 month audit period.

PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard): Required for any project handling credit card data. Key requirements: cardholder data environment (CDE) segmentation, encryption of card data at rest and in transit, quarterly vulnerability scans, annual penetration testing, and strict access controls. Minimize scope by tokenizing where possible.

Data residency requirements vary by country and must be checked per-project. Common patterns: EU (GDPR — data can stay in EEA or countries with adequacy decisions), Russia (personal data must be stored in Russia), China (PIPL — data localization with cross-border transfer assessment), India (DPDP Act — critical personal data must stay in India). Always confirm with legal.
